text: Our guide was so knowledgeable and funny. Best food tour we've done anywhere.
Loved the izakaya stops but we walked too fast between them, my parents struggled.
Great food but I'm vegetarian and only two of the six tastings worked for me.
The meeting point was hard to find, we were 10 minutes late and missed the first stop.
Fantastic hidden alleys, felt like we saw where locals actually eat.
A bit expensive for what was included, drinks should not be extra at this price.
Group was 14 people, too big to hear the guide in the narrow lanes.
Learned so much about Japanese etiquette and the history of the yokocho.
It was extremely hot and humid in August, more water breaks would help.
We have a toddler in a stroller and some stairs were difficult. Please say so when booking.
Halal options were clearly explained, thank you for planning this so carefully.
The tour ran 40 minutes over and we missed our dinner reservation.
Guide's English was clear and she answered every question.
Too crowded at the famous market, the quieter side streets were much better.
Would love a private tour option for our family next time.
Rain all evening but the guide had umbrellas for everyone. Great service.
Portions were small, I was still hungry afterwards.
Booking confirmation email never arrived, had to message on WhatsApp.
Great value, more tastings than I expected.
My wife has a shellfish allergy and the guide checked every dish. Very reassuring.
Felt rushed at the end, three hours was not enough for all the stops.
The sake tasting was the highlight, very well explained.
Not suitable for someone with limited mobility, lots of walking and steps.
A small group of six made it feel personal and relaxed.
Expected more about the history of the area and less shopping.
Start time of 5pm was perfect after a day of sightseeing.
We booked the English tour but the guide often switched to Japanese with the shop owners without translating.
Vegan friend had almost nothing to eat. Please offer a plant-based version.
Would pay more for a smaller group.
The ramen stop was incredible, we went back the next day.
Guide recommended places for the rest of our trip, super helpful.
Hard to find the start, the map in the email pointed to the wrong exit.
Too much walking in the heat, would prefer fewer stops closer together.
Great for first-time visitors, explained how to order and pay.
Kids loved the sweets, but it was a long evening for them.
Price seemed fair compared with other tours we looked at.
ガイドさんがとても親切で、英語の説明も分かりやすかったです。
La comida estaba deliciosa, pero el grupo era demasiado grande.
Queue at the first stop took 25 minutes, that time could have been used better.
Gluten-free options were limited but the guide tried hard.
